name: Klaven's Tower
summary: Klaven's Tower is a covert SI:7 infiltration mission assigned to Alliance rogues in Westfall. Operating on intelligence from Agent Kearnen, agents must pickpocket a key, break into a heavily guarded Defias outpost, and retrieve sinister documents linked to unnatural experiments.

sections.title: A Stakeout in Westfall
sections.body: At the southeastern edge of Westfall, near the river and north of the Dagger Hills, stands a lonely stone spire claimed by the Defias Brotherhood. While the Brotherhood's human thieves and brigands are common across the plains, Agent Kearnen noticed strange developments after weeks of solitary surveillance. A bizarre shipment recently arrived directly from the shadowed woods of Duskwood, escorted by monstrous, deformed sentries unlike any ordinary highwaymen.

sections.title: The Spire and the Spiked Guard
sections.body: The tower is commanded by Klaven Mortwake and guarded by bizarrely altered sentries whose breathing is harsh and labored. Among these shambling guards is a hulking zombie driven with iron spikes, who carries the Defias Tower Key. Stealing the key requires silence and finesse, enabling an operative to bypass the ground defenses, slip into the upper levels of the stronghold, and crack open the padlocked Duskwood Chest.

sections.title: Zanzil's Concoction
sections.body: Recovered from the chest, Klaven Mortwake's personal journal details a grim partnership linking the Defias, the Venture Company, and the jungle trolls of Stranglethorn. The writings reveal that the witch doctor Zanzil discovered an alchemical poison potent enough to raise unthinking, obedient undead drones. For Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7, this discovery exposes the Defias's expanding ambitions and makes a firm understanding of poisons essential for its agents.

faq.answer: Klaven's Tower lies at the southeastern edge of Westfall, near the river and north of the Dagger Hills. It serves as a secure, fortified redoubt for the Defias Brotherhood.

aliases: who is the rogue in westfall
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen is an operative for Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. She has spent weeks secretly watching Klaven's Tower from a nearby camp, tracking strange shipments and plotting an infiltration.

faq.q: What makes the guards at Klaven's Tower unusual?
faq.answer: Unlike the standard human bandits of the Defias, the sentries guarding the tower are mutated undead drones. They are mindless laborers created through an exotic alchemical concoction shipped into Westfall.

faq.q: How does the Defias have undead servants?
faq.answer: The Defias procured a specialized toxic brew concocted by the jungle troll witch doctor Zanzil in Stranglethorn Vale. Through deals involving the Venture Company, this poison was imported to turn living subjects into obedient drones.
Klaven Mortwake is a high-ranking Defias overseer stationed at the tower. He oversaw the receipt of dark shipments from Duskwood and kept a private journal detailing their sinister alchemy.

faq.q: Why does Mathias Shaw care about the recovered journal?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw requires actionable intelligence on Defias alliances and dangerous foreign agents. Learning that Zanzil's trolls can manufacture undeath via poison alerts SI:7 to a grave new threat facing Stormwind, compelling the agency to train its operatives thoroughly in venomcraft.

angles.text: This covert infiltration is a defining rite of passage for Alliance rogues, demanding mastery of stealth, pickpocketing, lockpicking, and exploitation of enemy physical vulnerabilities.

Uncovering the Defias plot at the tower reveals that the rebels are not mere aggrieved masons, but dangerous conspirators willing to traffic with jungle trolls and dark alchemy to threaten the kingdom.
Human defenders of Stormwind are horrified to see their former countrymen twisted into mindless undead drones in Westfall.
